note: Curated, verifiable advisory snapshot shipped with cyberpowerfull. It is deliberately small: import the current NVD and CISA KEV feeds with tools/bash/cve_hunt.sh --import-feed for full-year coverage (including newly published 2025-2026 CVEs). Every range below states the affected interval; verify against the vendor advisory before reporting.

advisories.title: Log4j2 JNDI features remote code execution (Log4Shell)
advisories.description: JNDI lookup expansion in Log4j2 allows remote code execution when message lookups are enabled.

advisories.title: Log4j2 incomplete fix for JNDI lookup (2.15.0)
advisories.description: The 2.15.0 fix for Log4Shell was incomplete; certain lookup patterns still allow code execution or denial of service.

advisories.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal and file disclosure
advisories.description: A flaw in path normalisation allows traversal outside the document root, and may allow remote code execution when mod_cgi is enabled.

advisories.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 path traversal and RCE
advisories.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773: traversal sequences still bypass normalisation, enabling file disclosure and possible code execution.

advisories.title: Spring Framework data binding remote code execution (Spring4Shell)
advisories.description: Data binding on JDK 9+ with Spring MVC or WebFlux can allow an attacker to modify class loader state and write a web shell.

advisories.title: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST authentication bypass
advisories.description: Undisclosed requests to the iControl REST interface may bypass authentication and allow command execution.

advisories.title: MOVEit Transfer SQL injection leading to data theft
advisories.description: SQL injection in the MOVEit Transfer web application allowed mass exploitation and data exfiltration in 2023.
advisories.note: Product-level match: confirm the installed MOVEit version against the vendor advisory before reporting.

advisories.title: OpenSSH signal handler race condition (regreSSHion)
advisories.description: A race condition in sshd's signal handling may allow unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux.

advisories.title: XZ Utils backdoor in liblzma
advisories.description: Malicious code in xz/liblzma 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 hooks the OpenSSH build and allows authentication bypass via a crafted certificate.

advisories.title: PHP CGI argument injection on Windows
advisories.description: Character conversion on Windows code pages allows argument injection in PHP CGI, leading to remote code execution.

advisories.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect command injection
advisories.description: Unauthenticated command injection in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS allows arbitrary command execution as root.

advisories.title: Apache Tomcat AJP file inclusion (Ghostcat)
advisories.description: The AJP connector allows file read and, with file upload, potential code execution when exposed to untrusted networks.
